items.definition:
happening by chance or unexpectedly
It was an accidental discovery.

relating to or resembling metal
The robot had a shiny metallic surface.

suffering from decay
The apple was rotten inside.

serving to make something look more attractive; ornamental
The vase is purely decorative and not meant for holding water.

containing a lot of fat
Avoid eating too many fatty foods.

covered with hair; difficult or dangerous
The dog has very hairy legs. That was a hairy situation.

not pleasant
The smell was very unpleasant.

careful
Be cautious when crossing the road.

not causing harm
Don't worry; the snake is completely harmless.

feeling or inspiring hope
She was hopeful about her chances of getting the job.

relating to Hungary or its people/language
She is learning Hungarian to communicate with her relatives.

existing only in the imagination
She had an imaginary friend when she was a child.

likely to happen or be true
It's probable that it will rain tomorrow.

having an allergy
I am allergic to peanuts.

clearly stated or decided; not vague or doubtful
We need a definite answer by tomorrow.

barely perceptible; lacking strength or vigor
We heard a faint sound in the distance.

recently born
The hospital nursery was full of newborn babies.

of or relating to a parent or parents
Children need parental guidance as they grow up.

not desired or wished for
She received a lot of unwanted advice.

causing delight; charming
We had a delightful evening with our friends.

of or relating to flowers
She chose a dress with a beautiful floral pattern.

of heaven; delightful
The cake tasted heavenly.

unwilling to change one's mind
He was too stubborn to admit he was wrong.

having an excessive desire for something, especially wealth
The greedy child wanted all the candy for himself.

easily seen or observed
There was a noticeable change in his attitude.

not certain or confident
I'm unsure about the best way to proceed.

above a weight considered normal or healthy
The doctor advised him that he was overweight.

not changed
The situation remained unchanged despite our efforts.

able to be understood
Her reasons for leaving were completely understandable.

like a child in a bad sense; silly and immature
His childish behavior annoyed everyone at the meeting.

not yet paid
He has a lot of unpaid bills.

not achieving the desired aim or result
Their attempt to climb the mountain was unsuccessful.

not confident or certain; not firmly fixed
She felt insecure about her appearance.

not completed
The painting was still unfinished when the exhibition opened.

not liked by many people
The new policy proved to be very unpopular with the public.

showing or involving great activity or vitality
The children were very energetic after their nap.

feeling or causing despair about something
The situation seemed hopeless, but they kept trying.

relating to men; strong
He has a very masculine voice.

showing respect
Please be respectful to your elders.

relating to or produced by a volcano
The island has a volcanic origin.

crisp
The autumn air was crisp and cool.

not working; lazy
He spent the whole day idle, doing nothing.

not regular or even
The shape of the table was irregular.

full of juice; interesting
The orange was very juicy and sweet.

often changing moods; gloomy
He can be quite moody sometimes, happy one minute, sad the next.

fashionable and elegant
She always wears very stylish clothes.

not ready, eager, or prepared to do something
She was unwilling to accept the compromise.

unable to defend oneself or to act without help
He felt helpless watching the situation unfold.

slightly wet
The cake was deliciously moist.

able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage
This material is very durable and will last a long time.

taking place or progressing slowly or by degrees
There has been a gradual improvement in his health.

Not showing a proper sense of responsibility.
It was irresponsible of him to leave the door unlocked.

Having well-developed muscles.
The athlete had a very muscular physique.

having beautiful natural scenery
We drove along a scenic route through the mountains.

not safe; dangerous
The old bridge was declared unsafe for vehicles.

extremely bad or unpleasant
The weather was dreadful all weekend.

not fully developed; childish
His immature behavior annoyed everyone.

old-fashioned or obsolete
This software is outdated and needs to be updated.

situated in or directed toward the southeast
The southeastern region of the country is known for its warm climate.

Conforming to the current fashion.
She always wears fashionable clothes.

relating to numbers
The data is presented in numerical order.

close to the actual, rough
The approximate cost of the repairs is $500.

comfortable and warm
The small cottage felt very cozy in winter.

showing a lack of respect
His comments were very disrespectful to the elderly.
